new: Every story is now a story package: the tour, the muscle story, tissue and time, the shape of tissue and Pass it on moved, and the airports, proteins and cell map stories were wrapped as they are.
Each one is the same story as before, with the same link, the same place on the Stories screen and the same miniature at its station in a shared room.
Their narrations now live in their own folders (Pass it on keeps its German one too), so a headset downloads each one again the first time it plays.
If the list of stories is slow to arrive, the app now waits for it instead of failing to start.
test: Open each story from the Stories screen on a laptop and in a headset: it should load, play with its narration and open explore mode.
Play the airports story with sound: the recording should still line up with the globe, chapter by chapter.
Switch Pass it on to German and back while it plays: each language should have its voice.
A plain start (no story in the address) should still open the airports behind the Stories screen, with the tutorial last.
Old links to proteins.html and spatial.html should still open those stories.
With Take all stories done, go offline and open the airports and two other stories.
untested: The moved stories in a real headset session, their narrations there, and a shared room of several headsets.
How the narration downloads behave on a slow network at an event.
How the narrations sound: unheard here.
